name: Moonlit Veil
source:
Halloween is your favorite night of the year, and you and your friends are more excited for it this year than any other. But you're a bit too old for trick or treating now; being seniors in high school, you've moved on to greener pastures -- the Halloween dance! The three of you still need to finish your costumes, but soon it'll be time. One way or another, you'll have the night of your lives.

But... something seems a bit off. As the night draws nearer, you get the feeling there's something going on in the background. One of your friends clearly knows something she's not telling you, and some of the things that have been happening are.. odd.

Can you figure out what's going on? Or... do you even need to? Maybe it's fine to just ignore it and have a good time. What's the worst that could happen?

[From [url=https://heecawroo.itch.io/moonlit-veil]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
万圣节是你一年中最喜欢的夜晚，而今年你和朋友们比以往任何时候都更加期待。可你们已经不适合再去讨糖了；身为高中毕业班学生，你们决定改去参加万圣节舞会！你们三人还得赶紧完成装扮，但很快就要出发了。无论如何，这一夜都会令人终生难忘。

不过……似乎有些不对劲。随着夜幕临近，你感觉暗中正发生着什么。其中一位朋友显然知道些什么，却不肯告诉你；最近发生的一些事情也……有些古怪。

你能弄清楚发生了什么吗？或者……真的需要弄清楚吗？也许不管这些，好好享受夜晚就行。最坏又能怎样？

[来源：[url=https://heecawroo.itch.io/moonlit-veil]Itch.io[/url]]
